Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A single financial transaction record (income or expense) logged by the user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this transaction.

type.description: Whether this transaction is an expense or income.

amount.description: Transaction amount in IDR (must be positive).

category.description: Category name of the transaction (e.g., Makanan, Transportasi, Gaji).

wallet.description: Wallet or payment method (e.g., Tunai, Rekening Bank, E-Wallet).

note.description: Optional user note or description for the transaction.

dateMillis.description: Transaction occurrence date in milliseconds since epoch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when transaction was last modified.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Monthly budget target for a specific category.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this budget target.

monthlyLimit.description: Maximum spending budget for the month.

monthYear.description: Year and month string in format YYYY-MM.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when budget was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when budget was last modified.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Collection of transactions belonging to a specific user.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Collection of category budgets set by a specific user.
